title: Variant Bridge Catalog refresh: tokenizer & runtime alignment
creator: Ava Chen
description: Maintain and refresh the Variant Bridge Catalog that drives smart routing fallbacks. Scope: validate and update compatibility metadata for model variant pairs used by regional/tier routing and automated fallback policies. Focus areas: tokenizer encoding parity, effective context/KV cache mapping, runtime flags and kernel compatibility, and surrounding tooling (serializer/deserializer, eval harnesses). Deliverables include an updated catalog, automated parity checks in CI, a remediation runbook for detected incompatibilities, and a dashboard view for routing health metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Top-12 fallback pairings have explicit tokenizer and context compatibility entries in the catalog
Automated parity tests (tokenizer round-trip, KV cache replay) added to CI and green on main for the protected pairs
Routing layer (region/tier rules) references the refreshed catalog and falls back only to validated variants unless configured for graceful degradation
Dashboard shows per-pair failure rate < 0.1% and a historical trend for the last 30 days
Runbook for remediating incompatibilities (PR templates, backfill steps, canary plan) documented and linked from the catalog
tasks: Inventory current variant pairings used by smart routing policies (region + tier) and export existing compatibility metadata
Standardize the compatibility schema: tokenizer_version, tokenization_notable_deltas, kv_cache_compat, runtime_flags_required, tooling_notes
Implement tokenizer round-trip tests and small-context KV replay tests in the eval harness
Add CI job 'variant-parity-check' to run on model-catalog and routing-policy changes
Update routing config loader to reject fallback targets not present in the verified catalog unless --allow-graceful-degradation is set
Populate catalog entries for top-12 pairings and run a sweep across non-top variants with sampling
Fix top-2 mismatches discovered during sweep and open follow-up PRs for model packaging fixes
Add a dashboard tile in Redwood Console: 'Fallback Variant Health' with perish-rate, avg-latency delta, and last-compat-scan
comments: 2026-02-10 - Ava Chen: Initial triage completed. Prioritized top-12 pairings based on traffic and fallback frequency (query attached in confluence). Proposal: containerized test runner that imports both tokenizers and compares tokenization + detokenization over a shared corpus (see GH gist: https://github.com/redwood-inference/variant-parity/gists/encode-test).

Also requested telemetry tags for routing fallback events (route, requested_variant, fallback_variant, parity_check_status).
